black_belt.name: Black Belt
dialog: I come up here to train in the fog. When you can't see, you learn to listen.
My reflexes have never been sharper!

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Ernest: Fog or no fog, I know a strong trainer when I see one. Let's battle!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Ernest: I saw that coming... about three moves too late.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Alyssa: Training in the fog sharpens every sense. Shall we put mine to the test?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Alyssa: My senses are sharp. Yours are sharper, it seems.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ninja Boy Joel: Out of the grass and into battle! You'll never see us coming!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ninja Boy Joel: You saw all four of us coming. How?

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ninja Boy Nathan: In fog like this, a ninja hardly needs to hide at all! Ha!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ninja Boy Nathan: Maybe I should have hidden properly after all.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ninja Boy Davido: You thought I was a rock, didn't you? Everybody does!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ninja Boy Davido: Back to being a rock, then. A quiet, beaten rock.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Dragon Tamer Patrick: Dragons raised in these mountains grow up tough. Mine's no exception!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Dragon Tamer Patrick: It's still young. One day it'll be a dragon nobody can stand against.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Bird Keeper Brianna: My owls see through fog as if it were broad daylight. Can you?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Bird Keeper Brianna: They saw you clearly enough. They just couldn't stop you.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Zac: Jen and I train together and battle together. Two against two!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Zac: Sorry, Jen. That one was my fault.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Jen: Zac's always one step behind me. That's how we like it!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Jen: Zac, we need to have a little talk about teamwork.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Veteran Brian: I've battled on this road for longer than you've been alive. Come, show me what the young can do.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Veteran Brian: Splendid. Every year the young ones get better. That's just as it should be.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Black Belt Adam: I run up this slope every morning to build my legs. You'll do nicely as the last stretch!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Black Belt Adam: Ugh... my legs gave out before my spirit did.

Grandma Wilma's House
Knock and come in: the kettle is always on.
